h: Tope Alabi's lawyers warn against defamatory claims over Toluwanisings' death
p: Lawyers for gospel singer Tope Alabi have reportedly warned online commentators against making defamatory claims that link her to the death of the content creator Toluwanisings. The legal team said it would act against anyone who keeps spreading the claims.
more: The singer has not been accused of any offence by authorities.
Fans have been urging people to wait for facts.
